 News 
 Visor Fest 
 Visor Fest 2027 announces its dates: 24 and 25 September at La Marina de València, with the first tier of passes sold out in an hour
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Clara Belmonte 
 18 Nov 2026, 10:00 
 A 3-minute read 
 Visor Fest · courtesy of the organisers 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Visor Fest 2027 will take place on Friday 24 and Saturday 25 September at La Marina de València , its third edition in the city, with no acts announced yet. 
 The first tier of passes, at €52, sold out within the first hour of sale ; the second tier, at €63, is now on sale through the official ticketing site. 
 The festival is sticking to its formula of a single stage and no clashing sets , the same one that in 2026 brought together Manic Street Preachers, Ride, The Damned and Ocean Colour Scene. 
 Visor Fest has set its dates for 2027. The festival of concerts by established international bands announced on Tuesday 17 November that it will return to La Marina de València on Friday 24 and Saturday 25 September 2027 , and at the same time opened sales of passes at a reduced price. The first tier lasted less than an hour.
 Festival guide 
 Visor Fest 2027 
 24–25 Sep 2027 · València 
 Tickets 
 Disponibles 
 24 and 25 September, at La Marina de València
 The night before, the festival announced on its social media that on Tuesday at 12:00 it would reveal “dates and the first passes at a special price”. At that time, its official website published the announcement: “Visorfest 2027, we have our dates! On 24 and 25 September we’re back with you at La Marina de Valencia”.
 It will be the third edition in València , according to the website itself, following five in Benidorm and Murcia. The 2026 edition was held on 25 and 26 September at Marina Norte , the open-air venue on the city’s seafront. The 2027 announcement mentions La Marina without specifying the exact space, and no artists have been confirmed yet: the festival simply promises that the next edition “will be huge”.
 The image the festival used to announce the 2027 dates. Image: Visor Fest Visor Fest 2027 passes: €52 tier sold out and €63 on sale
 Official sales are on Enterticket , which is linked from the festival’s tickets page . This was the situation on 18 November at 9:28:
 General pass, first tier: €52, sold out.
 General pass, second tier: €63, on sale, with a maximum of six per purchase.
 The ticketing site does not state in advance whether booking fees are added to that price, so it is worth checking the total before paying. There are also no day tickets or VIP passes for now, and the festival has not said how many tiers there will be or at what price. Buying now means doing so without a line-up, in exchange for the lowest price still available; if you are only going for one particular band, the sensible thing is to wait for the first names.
 A festival of concerts, with no clashes
 Visor Fest describes itself as “a festival of concerts”: a single stage, full sets one after another and DJ sessions during changeovers, with no need to choose between two bands playing at the same time. In 2026, each day started at 18:30 and ended with the last concert at 00:30, as we reported in the Visor Fest 2026 timetable .
 That edition’s line-up looked to British and alternative rock from the eighties and nineties. On the Friday, Hoodoo Gurus, New Model Army, The Damned, celebrating their 50th anniversary, and Ocean Colour Scene played; on the Saturday, The Wannadies, Gene, Ride and Manic Street Preachers. The announcements came in stages: first Ride, Ocean Colour Scene, New Model Army and The Wannadies and then, in April, Manic Street Preachers and The Damned .
 We will add news about the 2027 edition to the Visor Fest page . The weekend of 24 and 25 September has more events in the festival calendar for July to September 2027 , and the rest of the listings for the area are in festivals in Valencia .
 Sources: official Visor Fest website (home page and tickets page) and official sales on Enterticket, consulted on 17 and 18 November 2026; official Visor Fest profile on X (16 November 2026); ModoFestival news stories about Visor Fest 2026.
